column1: # Stage 2: -C target-feature=+cssc. Same source, two builds.
# `target-cpu=native` resolves to apple-m4, which does not model FEAT_CSSC even though the
# hardware has it. Enabling it turns 44 rbit+clz pairs into 46 single ctz, 9 of them in the
# worker. `trailing_zeros()` runs three times per row on the chain from the load to the table
# slot, so if instruction count on that chain matters at all, it should show here.
# Both builds carry the new 1 MiB chunk default.
# +cssc has since become the default, so re-running this inverts the snapshot: build the tree as
# it stands to get the `cssc` arm, then drop the flag and build again for the `base` arm.
#   mkdir -p target/cssc/release && cp target/release/v12_pairs target/release/hot_floor target/cssc/release/
# Snapshot immediately before the change and from a clean tree, or the A/B is against the wrong
# The same comparison with the read taken out, so a null result at the top can be told apart
